core.title: Rough Iron Heart Pull, Acorn RP2BP

text.description_html:
Acorn RP2BP, Rough Iron Heart Pull

The Rough Iron Heart Pull is great for garden gates or small outside doors; and will blend in beautifully with many landscapes. Acorn's RP2BP features heart shaped mounting ends. It features an easy screw-in installation. The beautiful rough black iron finish has a lifetime no rust warranty. The weathered appearance of cast iron duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals.

If you want a heart shaped latch to lock your gate, we recommend using an Acorn Rim Gate Latch for a matching set.

Specifications of the Rough Iron Heart Pull Acorn RP2BP:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 9-1/4"
  • Width: 2-5/6"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Material: Cast Iron
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
